intro: Here at Hack n Stay, we're passionate about sharing the magic of connected horse riding in Golden Bay. Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced rider, we have a horse trek suited to you!

We offer riders of all experience levels opportunities to learn more about the foundations of good horsemanship whilst experiencing stunning coastal scenery of Golden Bay on horseback. With a focus on teaching light and balanced riding, our guided holistic horse riding experiences are so much more than just a trail ride.

Our professionally guided horse treks provide a safe and fun environment to further your riding knowledge, build confidence and challenge yourself. Whether you're looking for a Short Ride to sample the beauty of Golden Bay on horseback or an extended Full Day Ride to fully immerse yourself in the local culture, cuisine and stunning coastal scenery – we have a variety of options just for you!

planner.title: What does the sunrise and tide Ride Planner do?
body: The Ride Planner is a first-party tool for Patons Rock beach rides. It shows sunrise timing and tide clearance for Wednesday, Friday and Sunday sunrise rides so you can pick a workable week before continuing to live FareHarbor booking.

It is built for guests booking Hack n Stay guided rides at Hack Farm near Patons Rock in Golden Bay — not a generic tide table. Use it when tides matter; Hack Track on-farm rides can still be booked on any open date.

categoriesLead: Open a category to see the rides, then jump straight to booking.

rides.title: Hack Track / Fairy Trail Loop Ride
rides.description: The perfect introduction to balanced riding for riders of all ages — a 1 hour ride through rolling farm country, native forest, and ocean views. On-farm and bushland only.

rides.title: Patons Rock Beach Ride
rides.description: Our most popular ride for all abilities. Follow the Hack Track down to the beach and explore Golden Bay's coastal vistas.

rides.title: Sunrise Beach Ride
rides.description: Ride through native forest and farm country to the beach as the sun rises over Golden Bay. Glow-worms possible on the way back when conditions allow. Wed, Fri & Sun — tide-checked.

rides.title: Swimming / Playing with Horses in the Water
rides.description: Ride to Patons Rock Beach, untack, and splash in crystal-clear water with your horse. Magical and weather dependent.

rides.title: Rangi Ride
rides.description: Beach, headland, estuary and reserve — up to about 4.5 hours through changing landscape, birdlife and great beaches. Intermediate to experienced riders.

rides.title: Mussel Inn – Ale Trail
rides.description: Beach and headland ride with river crossings to the Mussel Inn hitching rail — a drink and snack on us, then ride home before the next high tide. Tide and weather dependent.

rides.title: Collingwood Explorer
rides.description: Beach ride to Collingwood village past rock formations and art displays, with time for a café stop before returning. Experienced riders only — tide and weather dependent.

rides.title: Flexible packages with accommodation
rides.description: Design your own horse holiday — vaulting, riding or horsemanship with homestead accommodation included. Each night includes a full day of horseback activities tailored to your group.

rides.title: Ride & Fly
rides.description: Combine trail riding with the thrill of vaulting movements — find balance, confidence and connection with the horse in a unique way.

rides.title: Arena Lesson
rides.description: On-farm arena time focused on light, balanced riding and horsemanship foundations for all experience levels.

rides.title: Vaulting Arena Session
rides.description: Vaulting lessons and experiences for all ages — dancing and gymnastics on horseback, often described as the safest equestrian discipline.

request.eyebrow: Not sure what you need yet? Prefer to sort it out with a person first.
request.title: Booking Request Form
request.body: If you'd rather coordinate directly — or you're looking at a full-day, multi-day, vaulting or custom experience — send a request and we'll help you confirm times around tide and weather.
